'''Infobox proposal B''' sandbox, pass 2. Live [[Template:Card]] is unchanged. Tests use [[Template:Card/sandbox]].

The box splits into '''Identity''' (GEMP ID, PC alias, slip, era, Versions, predecessor, successor) and '''Face''' (stats). Title carries uniqueness dots. Force Icons are separate from Icons. Text state and GEMP title are omitted.

'''Versions''' lists every version of the same card, oldest era first, regular then [[Alternate Image]] within an era. '''Predecessor''' / '''Successor''' walk that list: regular → same-era AI → next era's regular. AI is a same-era art variant.
